remarks: Welcome to maintenance-free living in Strawberry Woods-one of Stamford's most sought-after private communities. Ideally located in mid-city, this spacious end-unit townhome is just a short walk to the train, shops, restaurants, fitness centers, schools, and houses of worship, yet privately set within 19 acres of beautifully manicured grounds.  The main level features an open-concept living and dining area with hardwood floors, double sliders, and a wood-burning fireplace, leading to a private patio.  Upstairs, the primary suite includes two double closets and an ensuite bath. The second bedroom has access to a private balcony. A third-floor loft provides additional space-perfect for a home office, den, or studio. Walk-in attic offers generous storage and future potential.  Additional features: gas heat, central air, in-unit washer/dryer on main level, attached garage, and ample guest parking. Community amenities include a heated inground pool and clubhouse.  Don't miss this rare opportunity to own an end-unit in one of Stamford's premier locations!
